title: Context-Coordinate Identifiability, Minimal Sufficient State Reconstruction, Anti-Rationalization Constraint, Counterfactual Coordinate Deletion, Prospective Context Compression, Cross-Domain Equivalence-Class Transport, Irreducible Interaction Tests & the Boundary between Legitimate X Refinement and Post-Hoc State Expansion

compression_program.delete: Remove one coordinate at a time and test whether admitted action structure changes.
compression_program.merge: Merge coordinates when one is derivable from or observationally inseparable from another over the admitted worlds.
compression_program.derive: Prefer deterministic derivation to primitive promotion.
compression_program.quotient: Collapse representation-only variants before minimality claims.
compression_program.minimality: X_min is an equivalence class of context representations that preserves the admitted action partition with no admissible primitive coordinate removable under the frozen tests.

prospective_tests.leave_one_coordinate_out: For each admitted primitive coordinate, delete it and recompute action-equivalence classes.
prospective_tests.pairwise_merge: Merge candidate coordinates and test whether action structure is preserved.
prospective_tests.cross_domain_transport: Apply the frozen compressed representation to fresh software domains not used to motivate the coordinate grammar.
prospective_tests.irreducible_interaction: Require at least one fresh action reversal/discrimination that survives under X_min × G and disappears under a strictly smaller context representation.
prospective_tests.anti_rationalization: Any coordinate introduced after an observed failure is development-only until independently re-precommitted and prospectively discriminated.

r2_gate: LAW-R2 remains unauthorized unless fresh prospectively admitted worlds are materially identical in (X_min,G,E) yet require conflicting actions after representation normalization and all admissible coordinate reconstruction attempts.
